mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_account (user_id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, enabled, roles, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, #{roles}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, tenant_id, username, password_hash, enabled, roles, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_user_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at
